text.en:
The Task Force may provide direct and indirect
grants to NGOs for the establishment and operation of family farm
schools and rural development centers from whichever funds that
it can generate from local and foreign sources. It may also enter
into such agreements or contracts, which it may deem appropriate
to effect the herein given mandate as may be warranted by circum-
stances relating to the source and use of funds, land ownership,
corporate character of the contracting parties and other relevant

The Secretary of Agriculture is hereby authorized
to sign and execute, for and in behalf of the Task Force, agree-
ments or contracts extending grants or other forms of assistance
entered into by the Task Force.

A Task Force Secretariat to be jointly formed by
the CAP and Department of Agriculture shall assist the Task
Force in the performace of its duties and functions.

The Task Force shall facilitate and coordinate
with the private sector for the establishment of agro-industrial
facilities.

The Task Force shall be authorized to call upon
any department, bureau, office, angecy or any instrumentality
of government for material and manpower assistance as may be
necessary in implementing the AIDA program.

All rights, duties, obligations, powers and functions
of the Task Force shall be transferred to the Department of Agricultu
effective June 30, 1992, or soon thereafter at the discretion of the

If any provision of this Order is declared unconstitu
tional or illegal, the other provisions hereof shall remain effective.
